Contract context <code>contract_context.9.agent-proof-rungs</code>:

| Field | Frozen rule |
|---|---|
| interface | layerx-proof receipt, inclusion and complete offline export verification reporting Rung |
| storage | none; pure functions over caller-supplied bytes |
| errors | VerificationFailure with ReceiptCheck, InclusionError, CompleteExportError with RungNotAchieved, ExportCodecError |
| events | none |
| gas | none |
| activation | rungs from wave 1; guarantor certificates and checkpoint facts retire in wave 6 |
| invariants | Receipted requires a sequencer key from the pinned ReceiptKeys list; no layerx-proof evidence reaches Committed after wave 6; verification uses no network, clock or ambient state |
| pause | none |
